Senses.Explanation: The tailoring line begins from sleeve and collar before its companion moves beneath the arm and into the garment. Xieyun Jiji uses the expression through direct tailor exchange contrasting collar-and-waist work with the matter at the needle point. Tianyin Yuanxiu independently deploys it through independent tailoring deployment in case appraisal.
